scope: Selected upstream kselftests on the unchanged complete EvoCC kernel and the frozen GCC reference kernel; not all kselftests or KUnit
testBuild: Upstream Makefiles, static userspace executables, frozen kernel UAPI headers. Identical binaries and initramfs in both flights.
scratchFilesystem: 64 MiB ext4, fresh QEMU snapshot in each flight; tmpfs at /tmp and /dev/shm
verdict: All selected programs finish with valid TAP; no subject failure, timeout, missing result, or reference PASS becoming SKIP. Reference failures prevent closure. Explicit upstream skips remain skips, never passes.
kunit: NOT_RUN: CONFIG_KUNIT is disabled in the frozen configuration
